text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I watch the other racers
train...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eek! I-I'm so sorry! I'm in the way,
aren't I? That's
right. I'm just a waste of space
taking up someone
else's place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calm Meisho Doto down and explain
that wasn't
what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I ask why she's staring at the
track, she tells
me she wanted to watch
T.M. Opera O run.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to follow her example, but I
don't
think I'm anywhere near good
enough to copy
her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She runs with so much power and
confidence...
She has everything I don't...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Confidence... That's the thing I lack the
most.
choice_data_list: First, let's learn from that unwav...
First, let's learn from that vital...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fake it till I make it...
Do you think it'll
work if I
make up a nickname for myself
like Opera has?
choice_data_list: Starting by looking the part is on...
Starting by looking the part is on...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If she's the "Centurial Overlord," maybe I
can be
the "Centurial Tempest" or
something.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Indeed, that is a positively
superb-sounding
name!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-Opera O?! Did... did you hear
all that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-please ignore me! There's no way I
could live up
to such an impressive
name!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto flees from us with the force
of a raging storm. In her haste, she
passes an entire
pack of training
Umamusume in an instant.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Her name truly speaks for itself! Haaah
ha ha!
choice_data_list: So this is... the "Century's End R...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Right. She is always radiating energy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But...
There's no way I can be like that...
It's just
too hard...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I might be able to do it if I had a

demonstration... Um... I'll try asking her
for one,
then.
choice_data_list: Let's ask her to demonstrate in pe...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-haaah... Ha ha—hack! Cough!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And now, strike a refined pose!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... A refined... pose...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa—eek?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Goodness. What an exceptionally unique pose! It seems I have things to learn from you!
